title: Platform Landscape Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: The whole set of platforms an enterprise runs, arranged in layers so that a platform consumes only the platforms in the layers below it, and only through their contracts. Records the layers, the platforms each holds and the dependencies between platforms.

layers.description: The layers, from L0 at the bottom upwards.

platforms.description: The platforms the layer holds. The inverse of layer on the platform.

dependencies.description: Which platform consumes which. The provider is in a lower layer than the consumer, and consumption is through the provider's contracts.

through.description: The contracts consumed: API-NNN, EV-NNN or a named interface.
